manual.title: Connect to your Managed Switch
manual.description: Works with managed switches with a Realtek chip, either with the common Realtek web interface of the original firmware or with RTLPlayground (detected automatically). Default credentials: admin / admin; RTLPlayground only uses the password (default 1234).
